001package com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import java.awt.Color;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.BaseCustomDialogDelegate;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CustomDialogDelegate;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.PlanetAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StoryPointActionDelegate;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.Industry;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.Industry.IndustryTooltipMode;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.PlanetInteractionDialogPluginImpl;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Industries;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Sounds;
019import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.SetStoryOption.BaseOptionStoryPointActionDelegate;
020import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.SetStoryOption.StoryOptionParams;
021import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.Alignment;

025
026public class TestIndustryOptionProvider extends BaseIndustryOptionProvider {
027
028        public static Object INTERACTION_PLUGIN = new Object();
029        public static Object INTERACTION_TRIGGER = new Object();
030        public static Object CUSTOM_PLUGIN = new Object();
031        public static Object STORY_ACTION = new Object();
032        public static Object IMMEDIATE_ACTION = new Object();
033        public static Object DISABLED_OPTION = new Object();
034        
035        @Override
036        public List<IndustryOptionData> getIndustryOptions(Industry ind) {
037                if (isUnsuitable(ind, false)) return null;
038                
039                
040                if (ind.getMarket().getId().equals("jangala") && ind.getId().equals(Industries.POPULATION)) {
041                        
042                        List<IndustryOptionData> result = new ArrayList<IndustryOptionData>();
043                        
044                        IndustryOptionData opt = new IndustryOptionData("Interaction dialog with plugin", INTERACTION_PLUGIN, ind, this);
045                        opt.color = Color.GREEN;
046                        result.add(opt);
047                        
048                        opt = new IndustryOptionData("Interaction dialog with rule trigger", INTERACTION_TRIGGER, ind, this);
049                        opt.color = Color.MAGENTA;
050                        result.add(opt);
051                        
052                        opt = new IndustryOptionData("Custom dialog plugin", CUSTOM_PLUGIN, ind, this);
053                        opt.color = Color.ORANGE;
054                        result.add(opt);
055                        
056                        opt = new IndustryOptionData("Story point action dialog", STORY_ACTION, ind, this);
057                        opt.color = Misc.getStoryOptionColor();
058                        result.add(opt);
059                        
060                        opt = new IndustryOptionData("Take an immediate action", IMMEDIATE_ACTION, ind, this);
061                        opt.color = Color.RED;
062                        result.add(opt);
063                        
064                        opt = new IndustryOptionData("Disabled option", DISABLED_OPTION, ind, this);
065                        opt.enabled = false;
066                        result.add(opt);
067                        
068                        return result;
069                }
070                return null;
071        }
072
073        @Override
074        public void createTooltip(IndustryOptionData opt, TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float width) {
075                if (opt.id == INTERACTION_PLUGIN) {
076                        tooltip.addPara("This option shows a standard interaction dialog with a custom plugin. "
077                                        + "In this case, the dialog used is the PlanetInteractionDialogPluginImpl,"
078                                        + " with Corvus - the star - as the target.", 0f);
079                } else if (opt.id == INTERACTION_TRIGGER) {
080                        tooltip.addPara("This option shows a rule-driven interaction dialog. In this case, "
081                                        + "the dialog targets the Asharu Terraforming Platform and fires the "
082                                        + "OpenInteractionDialog trigger to start the interaction.", 0f);
083                } else if (opt.id == CUSTOM_PLUGIN) {
084                        tooltip.addPara("This option shows a custom dialog driven by a CustomDialogDelegate implementation.", 0f);
085                } else if (opt.id == STORY_ACTION) {
086                        tooltip.addPara("This option brings up a dialog where the player may spend some number "
087                                        + "of story points to perform an action, and possibly receive bonus experience.", 0f);
088                } else if (opt.id == IMMEDIATE_ACTION) {
089                        tooltip.addPara("This option will not show a dialog but instead prints some text to standard out.", 0f);
090                } else if (opt.id == DISABLED_OPTION) {
091                        tooltip.addPara("This option is disabled.", 0f);
092                }
093        }
094        
095        @Override
096        public void optionSelected(IndustryOptionData opt, DialogCreatorUI ui) {
097                if (opt.id == INTERACTION_PLUGIN) {
098                        PlanetAPI planet = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("corvus").getStar();
099                        PlanetInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new PlanetInteractionDialogPluginImpl();
100                        // unpausing when exiting this dialog makes the outer interaction dialog 
101                        // (for the initial interaction with th market) unresponsive
102                        // since this is not a valid thing to do anyway - the game should not be unpaused 
103                        // while the market dialog is open - the cause remains uninvestigated -am
104                        plugin.setUnpauseOnExit(false);
105                        ui.showDialog(planet, plugin);
106                } else if (opt.id == INTERACTION_TRIGGER) {
107                        SectorEntityToken station = Global.getSector().getEntityById("corvus_abandoned_station");
108                        ui.showDialog(station, "OpenInteractionDialog");
109                } else if (opt.id == CUSTOM_PLUGIN) {
110                        CustomDialogDelegate delegate = new BaseCustomDialogDelegate() {
111                                @Override
112                                public void createCustomDialog(CustomPanelAPI panel, CustomDialogCallback callback) {
113                                        TooltipMakerAPI info = panel.createUIElement(800f, 500f, false);
114                                        info.addPara("Minimalistic custom dialog implementation.", 0f);
115                                        panel.addUIElement(info).inTL(0, 0);
116                                }
117                                
118                                @Override
119                                public boolean hasCancelButton() {
120                                        return true;
121                                }
122
123                                @Override
124                                public void customDialogConfirm() {
125                                        System.out.println("customDialogConfirm() called");
126                                }
127
128                                @Override
129                                public void customDialogCancel() {
130                                        System.out.println("customDialogCancel() called");
131                                }
132                        };
133                        ui.showDialog(800f, 500f, delegate);
134                } else if (opt.id == STORY_ACTION) {
135                        StoryOptionParams params = new StoryOptionParams(null, 1, "bonusXP_if_any_in_settings.json", 
136                                        Sounds.STORY_POINT_SPEND, 
137                                        "Performed a test action in TestIndustryOptionProvider");
138                        StoryPointActionDelegate delegate = new BaseOptionStoryPointActionDelegate(null, params) {
139                                @Override
140                                public void confirm() {
141                                }
142
143                                @Override
144                                public String getTitle() {
145                                        return null;
146                                }
147                                @Override
148                                public void createDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info) {
149                                        info.setParaInsigniaLarge();
150                                        info.addPara("Test action that costs one story point.", -10f);
151                                        info.addSpacer(20f);
152                                        super.createDescription(info);
153                                }
154                        };
155                        ui.showDialog(delegate);
156                } else if (opt.id == IMMEDIATE_ACTION) {
157                        System.out.println("IMMEDIATE ACTION TAKEN");
158                }
159                
160        }
161        
162        @Override
163        public void addToIndustryTooltip(Industry ind, IndustryTooltipMode mode, TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float width, boolean expanded) {
164                if (getIndustryOptions(ind) == null) return;
165                
166                float opad = 10f;
167                tooltip.addSectionHeading("TestIndustryOptionProvider", Alignment.MID, opad);
168                tooltip.addPara("Information about changes made to the this industry by "
169                                + "any of the custom options would go here.", opad);
170        }
171        
172}
